summary: The registrant, KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC, filed an 8-K to disclose its Transactional Net Asset Value (NAV) per share for multiple share classes as of July 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic valuation disclosure required for continuously offered closed-end funds, not a special-situation corporate event. There are no transactional terms, board recommendations, or structural changes beyond a class redesignation. The filing provides NAV figures and references an exhibit with additional details. Investors should monitor monthly NAV updates, as they determine share sale and repurchase prices.
